facts.business: La Tim Metal & Industries Ltd is engaged in manufacturing and dealing in color coated coils and profiles for the Indian market and has also ventured into export markets, especially Europe, and has a business segment in real estate development.
key_risks: Inflation and resultant sharp interest rate increases by the US government leading to fall in consumption and purchases
Currency depreciation of most countries against the US dollar
Global trade uncertainties and trade-related challenges
facts.related_party_note: During the year the company has not entered into any transaction of material nature with its promoters, the directors or the management, their subsidiaries or relatives etc, which may have potential conflict with the interest of the Company at large. All the details of transaction covered under related party transaction are given in the notes to accounts.
